title: A conservative functor to sets commuting with fibre products detects monomorphisms
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a category which has fibre products (pullbacks of pairs of morphisms with common target; [def-galois-finite-limits-colimits]), and let $F:\mathcal C\to\mathbf{Sets}$ be a functor which commutes with fibre products ([def-galois-exact-functor]) and reflects isomorphisms ([def-galois-reflects-isomorphisms]). Then a morphism $f:X\to Y$ of $\mathcal C$ is a monomorphism ([def-galois-initial-mono]) if and only if the map $F(f):F(X)\to F(Y)$ is injective.
